title: Quantitative Structure and Composition Determination by Including Thermal Vibrations in Inverse Multislice Ptychography
content: Thermal atom vibrations cause thermal diffuse scattering (TDS) of electrons which governs the darkfield in diffraction patterns (DP) and contains crucial information about the atomic structure and chemical composition. Its correct consideration in inverse schemes is a prerequisite for accurate specimen retrieval at elevated thickness. In this work we show the effects of neglecting TDS in different inverse multislice (IM) schemes which can result in unphysical phase artefacts and wrong chemical composition and temperature [1]. To overcome this model violation, we present a fully parametrized IM model [2] which explicitly includes TDS and directly retrieves chemical composition, structure and temperature quantitatively with high accuracy [1].
